sanjay: heads-up — we're evaluating removing `actor_id` from audit events to reduce PII surface. need opinions on: customer compatibility, KMS-wrapped payloads, and versioning approach. quick sync?

tyler: +1 to reducing PII but we need a clear migration path. we should add an explicit version field and a compatibility shim in deliveries. idea: `event_version` integer header.

maria: how will customers validate? if we change shape we must provide sample events + a validator script and a feature flag in the ingestion path. customers will need time to opt-in/opt-out.

irene: can we avoid a hard cut by supporting both shapes for reads for 90 days and emit deprecation warnings? also +1 to `event_version`.

sanjay: notes: KMS integration complicates things — encrypted payloads can't be inspected by validators unless we expose a derived plaintext sample or provide a verification endpoint. thoughts?

tyler: options: (1) keep top-level metadata unencrypted (headers + `event_version`) and encrypt only the payload blob; (2) provide a signed sample digest customers can fetch after auth; (3) provide a migration tool that rewraps events server-side. prefer (1) for minimal UX friction.

maria: (1) seems simplest for customers. if we keep `event_version` outside the encrypted blob we can route by version before decryption. need to update our KMS policy to allow the rewrap/migrate tooling to run.

irene: agree. also suggest a small schema compatibility matrix to communicate:
```
- version 1: has actor_id, ip_address, resource_path
- version 2: actor_id removed, actor_hash added, ip_address redacted
- version 3: payload encrypted blob + top-level metadata (event_version, timestamp, event_type)
```

sanjay: that matrix is good. proposal for rollout: feature-flagged writes (canary orgs) -> graceful reads of both versions -> 90d dual-read window -> deprecation notice -> force cut.

tyler: add automated regression evals: run synthetic prompts through common customer flows and compare event coverage before/after, plus unit tests for backward adapters.

maria: customer communication: provide a compatibility FAQ, example validators (python/js), and a sample dataset for testing. include instructions for on-prem/private customers to run validation locally if their payloads are already encrypted.

auditsvc-bot: staging feature-flag `audit_schema_v3` toggled ON for org `canary-1` by irene at 2026-03-18T16:02:14Z :white_check_mark:

irene: can someone draft the validator CLI? small spec:
- input: event file (ndjson) or stream
- can run in `--offline` mode to validate sample plaintext events
- `--expect-version N` to check compatibility
- exit codes: 0 pass, 2 warning (deprecated fields present), 3 fail

tyler: i'll prototype a go binary and a lightweight js lib. will post link when ready.

sanjay: action items for this thread:
- tyler: prototype validator + adapters (ETA 3 days)
- irene: enable canary flags + KMS policy check (ETA 2 days)
- maria: draft customer comms + sample dataset (ETA 4 days)
- sanjay: write runbook for dual-read window + deprecation timeline (ETA 5 days)

maria: also flag legal/compliance — removing actor_id might impact auditability for certain customers. I will loop in legal.

irene: small operational note: ensure our observability emits counts by `event_version` so we can monitor adoption.

sanjay: ok — thanks all. we'll reconvene after the validator prototype. :thumbsup:
